title: Joomla Site identity takes the email, hours and profiles the customer gave; an identity token whose braces a link percent-encoded is still filled, and still a token to the planner and the replace tool
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/identity-slots.test.mjs

S2: Run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/test/identity-plugin.test.mjs (php runs from the php:8.3-cli-alpine container when none is on PATH). Record whether any case is skipped.
S4: Run: node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='site identity takes|ride in the site block' apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-shared.test.mjs

S5: Run: node --input-type=module -e "import { contactOf } from './packages/cms/tracy-seeder/src/chrome-slots.mjs'; console.log(JSON.stringify([contactOf({contact:'0912 345 678 · hello@goldencrust.example · 12 Hang Bac, Hanoi'}), contactOf({contact:'Điện thoại: 0905 123 456, Địa chỉ: 12 Lê Lợi'}), contactOf({contact:'12 Hang Bac; Hanoi | Vietnam'})]))" and record the output.

S6: Run: node --input-type=module -e "import t from './packages/cms/tracy-seeder/src/chrome-slots.json' with { type: 'json' }; const p = t.profiles; console.log(JSON.stringify(['tracy-business/j6/1.2.0:module-4369','tracy-apple/j6/1.3.0:module-224','tracy-airbnb/j6/1.2.0:module-224'].map((s) => { const [c, e] = s.split(':'); return [4, 7, 9].map((i) => p[c][e + '.' + i].template) })))" and record the output.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 21): the identity module takes the email, hours and Instagram profile of the Golden Crust brief on all three identity profiles; Apply's own phone/email/address win over the joined line; every free-line case keeps labels, emails and second numbers out of the address; encoded token-only links are chrome and never reach the model.

S2 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0' (at least 13 tests): 'a token whose braces a link percent-encoded is filled like any other, in any letter case' and 'a layout tells a percent-encoded token with nothing behind it from one with a value' are 'ok'.
S3 exits 0 with 2 tests passed and '# fail 0': a link stored as tel:%7Bcontact.tel%7D (either case) answers with the apply that sets module-4369.5 (Site identity / phone) to 0909123456.
S4 exits 0 with 4 tests passed and '# fail 0'.

S5 prints exactly: [{"phone":"0912 345 678","email":"hello@goldencrust.example","address":"12 Hang Bac, Hanoi"},{"phone":"0905 123 456","email":null,"address":"12 Lê Lợi"},{"phone":null,"email":null,"address":"12 Hang Bac; Hanoi | Vietnam"}]
evidence: 05/10/2026 benchjoomlaapply01 (Tracy Business j6, Apply en-GB + vi-VN; the customer typed 0912 345 678, hello@goldencrust.example, 12 Hang Bac, Hanoi, Open 6am-8pm every day): the vi-VN top bar went out as href="tel:%7Bcontact.tel%7D" and href="mailto:%7Bcontact.email%7D"; the en-GB top bar had and the address line 'hello@goldencrust.example · 12 Hang Bac, Hanoi'. ng_modules 4369 held email '' and that address; 4126 (the derived vi copy of 428) held the encoded hrefs, re-saved by the Cowork plugin's ContentSlots::htmlPatch (PHP saveHTML, libxml2 2.9.14 in tracy/web-joomla:6-apache-20260923-r1).
fence: The identity module is written from the contact facts the customer gave (empty when none); every identity token spelling, raw or percent-encoded in either case, is filled by plg_system_tracyidentity, kept out of the planner's model batches, and read as Site identity's by the agent's replace tool.
